name: Malabar Cubing Clash 2025

venue.name: St Joseph's English Medium School
venue.address: Puthanangadi, Angadippuram PO, Perinthalmanna, Malappuram District, Kerala, 979321

information:
**Important Information for Participants**:

**Location**: The competition will take place at the main school hall.

**Arrival Time**: Please ensure that you arrive at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. Latecomers will not be permitted to participate.

**Volunteering**: All participants are kindly requested to volunteer during the competition.

**First-Time Participants**: If this is your first time participating in a WCA competition or if you're unfamiliar with the competition rules, we strongly recommend reviewing the WCA regulations beforehand.

**ID Requirement**: First-time participants are required to bring a scanned copy of their ID card. Please ensure you have this with you.

**Cube Requirement**: Participants must bring their own cubes. Participants are responsible for the safety of the puzzles. If you have difficulty bringing puzzles, please contact us in advance so that we can make arrangements for you.

**International Participants**: If you are a citizen from outside India, please submit a copy of your govt issued ID.

We look forward to seeing you at the competition! If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.
